__root__: layout: the document shell around every route; it has no page of its own
/: redirect relay: shows only a loading skeleton, then sends the user to sign-in, onboarding or the org; the onboarding journey stories follow it
/$orgSlug: layout: the org shell and the session and org gate; each child route has its own page story
/$orgSlug/chat/$: redirect: an old bookmark that opens the org home
/$orgSlug/knowledge-graph: redirect: an old bookmark that opens the org home
/$orgSlug/repositories/$: redirect: an old bookmark that opens the org home
/.auth/account: layout: renders only the outlet of the account views
/.auth/organization/$organizationView: redirect relay: sends the user to the organization settings of the selected org
/.notion/setup: redirect relay: a server route that returns a small document, with no React page
/.slack/setup: popup relay: stores the setup result and closes its own window
/.otel/v1/$signal: API route: a server proxy for browser telemetry, with no page
